name: fis-continuous-chaos-cicd-readiness-reporter
description: Reports whether continuous chaos testing is wired into delivery: AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) experiments automated in CodePipeline post-deployment, experiments gated by CloudWatch alarm stop conditions, CloudWatch Synthetics monitoring user experience during experiments, results tracked over time, and a regular GameDay cadence. Identifies gaps and a maturity level per application. Read-only and recommend-only - it reports and recommends, never starts or modifies an experiment or pipeline. Recommends the awslabs FIS-recommender MCP server as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SAT at 08:00 UTC
